posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
A somewhat complex method, but one that greatly reduces the number of conditions, is the use of reference variables or pointers (I don't know the correct term).
For example, instead of creating several conditions, I store the ID of each party member in a separate variable. This must be done right after adding the member to the group, as it is impossible to capture this value directly.
So in this example I created a list with values that refer only to the group members:
The examples below are of the first 3 standard items in Rm2k3:
Spoiler:
Potion example
Code:
@> Comment: // GET HERO'S ID FROM MEMBER 1
@> Control Variables: [0032:MenuPartyAct] = 40
@> Control Variables: [0032:MenuPartyAct] += Variable [0031]
@> Comment: // CHECKS IF THE MEMBER IS ALIVE
@> Control Variables: [0033:HP_TEMP] = Variable [0032]
@> Control Variables: [0033:HP_TEMP] += 4
@> Conditional Branch: Variable [0033:HP_TMP] > 0
  @> Change HP: Variable [0032], + 50
  @> Change Items: [Potion], - 1
  @> Call Event: [SE-Decision]
  @>
 : Else
  @> Call Event: [SE-Buzzer]
  @>
 : Branch End
Spoiler:
Hi-Potion example
Code:
@> Comment: // GET HERO'S ID FROM MEMBER 1
@> Control Variables: [0032:MenuPartyAct] = 40
@> Control Variables: [0032:MenuPartyAct] += Variable [0031]
@> Comment: // CHECKS IF THE MEMBER IS ALIVE
@> Control Variables: [0033:HP_TEMP] = Variable [0032]
@> Control Variables: [0033:HP_TEMP] += 4
@> Conditional Branch: Variable [0033:HP_TMP] > 0
  @> Change HP: Variable [0032], + 250
  @> Change Items: [Hi-Potion], - 1
  @> Call Event: [SE-Decision]
  @>
 : Else
  @> Call Event: [SE-Buzzer]
  @>
 : Branch End
Spoiler:
Magical Water (Recovery MP)
Code:
@> Comment: // GET HERO'S ID FROM MEMBER 1
@> Control Variables: [0032:MenuPartyAct] = 40
@> Control Variables: [0032:MenuPartyAct] += Variable [0031]
@> Comment: // CHECKS IF THE MEMBER IS ALIVE
@> Control Variables: [0033:HP_TEMP] = Variable [0032]
@> Control Variables: [0033:HP_TEMP] += 4
@> Conditional Branch: Variable [0033:HP_TEMP] > 0
  @> Change MP: Variable [0032], + 1
  @> Change Items: [Magic Water], + 80
  @> Call Event: [SE-Decision]
  @>
 : Else
  @> Call Event: [SE-Buzzer]
  @>
 : Branch End
Note that the action variable itself will do all the reading needed to affect the correct member.
But remember, this is a very crude example of how this works, but if you understand it, this can actually be used to create menus in Rm2k3 dynamically, but only in Rm2k3 because of the function of taking a single image and splitting it, and this function can be used to create a single image with all the items as long as the names are all the same length.
In this case I made a list with 6 columns and each column has 12 items:
I would make a tutorial, but I can't claim to have experience with all the parameters used or even combining them with variables, so this is what I can help with so far.
